diagnostics.message:
Solidity.Taclet.storageFieldOpAssignUnfoldLeftFst: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Stmt.step k✝ m✝
    (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.loc (Loc.field b✝ f✝ h✝)) fld✝ hfld✝) (Val.simple se✝))
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  Premise.unfold
    (Prog.cons (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.loc (Loc.field b✝ f✝ h✝)) fld✝ hfld✝) (Val.simple se✝))
      Prog.nil)
    Ext.refl

case loc.field
C✝ : Contract
k✝ : Nat
m✝ : Modality
Γ✝ : Ctx
p✝ : PrimTy
op✝ : BinOp
hop✝ : op✝.hasCompoundAssign = true
hp✝ : p✝.isNumeric = true
x✝ fld✝ : Name
hfld✝ : C✝.fieldType x✝ fld✝ = some (Ty.prim p✝)
se✝ : Simple C✝ Γ✝ p✝
s✝ : Name
b✝ : SPath C✝ Γ✝ (Ty.struct s✝)
f✝ : Name
h✝ : C✝.fieldType s✝ f✝ = some (Ty.struct x✝)
⊢ Stmt.step k✝ m✝
      (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.loc (Loc.field b✝ f✝ h✝)) fld✝ hfld✝) (Val.simple se✝)) =
    Premise.unfold
      (Prog.cons (Stmt.opAssign op✝ hop✝ hp✝ (OpLoc.field (SPath.loc (Loc.field b✝ f✝ h✝)) fld✝ hfld✝) (Val.simple se✝))
        Prog.nil)
      Ext.refl
